articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI release delayed to May 2026
articles.summary: Rockstar Games is delaying the release of Grand Theft Auto VI to May 26th, 2026. The developer says it needs more time to focus on the quality of the game.
articles.body: Rockstar Games is delaying the highly anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto VI to May 26th, 2026. The game had originally been planned to release in fall 2025, but Rockstar Games now says the team needs extra time “to deliver at the level of quality you expect and deserve.” In a message posted on the Rockstar Games website, the development team apologized for the delay: > We are very sorry that this is later than you expected. The interest and excitement surrounding a new Grand Theft Auto has been truly humbling for our entire team. We want to thank you for your support and your patience as we work to finish the game. > With every game we have released, the goal has always been to try and exceed your expectations, and Grand Theft Auto VI is no exception. We hope you understand that we need this extra time to deliver at the level of quality you expect and deserve. > We look forward to sharing more information with you soon. The first GTA VI trailer was revealed in December 2023, and since then we’ve heard very little about the game aside from the narrowed down release date that’s now been pushed to next year. The next installment in the Grand Theft Auto franchise will be set in Vice City, and feature the series’ first female protagonist — Lucia — with Bonnie and Clyde–inspired story elements. GTA VI is a highly anticipated title, and we might get some more details about the game’s delay during parent company Take-Two’s next financial results on May 15th. Take Two’s stock price dropped 8 percent in premarket trading on the NASDAQ this morning after the news of the delay. Grand Theft Auto V is still massively popular 11 years after its launch, recently taking the number one spot on Twitch as the most watched game of 2024.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launch delayed until November 2026
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI is being delayed again. It will now launch on November 19th, 2026. Previously, it was set to release in May 2026.
articles.body: Grand Theft Auto VI is being delayed again: it will now launch on November 19th, 2026. “We are sorry for adding additional time to what we realize has been a long wait, but these extra months will allow us to finish the game with the level of polish you have come to expect and deserve,” Rockstar Games says. “We want to thank you again for your patience and support. While the wait is a little longer, we are incredibly excited for players to experience the sprawling state of Leonida and a return to modern day Vice City.” Previously, GTA VI was set to launch on May 26th, 2026. Before that, Rockstar planned to release the game in 2025. It will be released on PS5 and Xbox Series X / S. “When we set a date, we really do believe in it,” Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick tells The Game Business. “We said when we set the last date, if a game requires more polish to be the best possible version of itself, then we will give that game more time. And that’s exactly what happened. We feel really good about this release date. It’s in the same fiscal year, it happens to be a great release window, and naturally we’re really supportive of Rockstar’s approach.” GTA VI will take place in Vice City and stars two protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. “Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them,” according to Rockstar’s description of the second trailer for the game, which was released in May. “But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.” Rockstar’s first GTA VI trailer debuted in late 2023. Last week, Rockstar was accused of union busting after firing 30 to 40 employees. A Rockstar spokesperson told Bloomberg that it took action against a “small number of individuals who were found to be distributing and discussing confidential information in a public forum” and that “this was in no way related to people’s right to join a union or engage in union activities.”

articles.title: Grupo Marbor consolida empreendimentos como referências em Mogi das Cruzes | G1
articles.standfirst: Vila Helio supera 90% de ocupação comercial, enquanto hotelaria e eventos ampliam a movimentação de visitantes e negócios na cidade
articles.summary: Vila Helio supera 90% de ocupação comercial, enquanto hotelaria e eventos ampliam a movimentação de visitantes e negócios na cidade
articles.body:
A elevada ocupação dos espaços comerciais, a procura por hospedagem e a movimentação de visitantes refletem a presença dos empreendimentos do Grupo Marbor na dinâmica econômica de Mogi das Cruzes. Com atuação nos setores imobiliário e de hotelaria, a empresa mogiana reúne negócios que atendem diferentes perfis de público e mantém investimentos voltados à qualificação de suas estruturas e à ampliação do portfólio.

Na Vila Helio, cerca de 80 empreendimentos de diferentes segmentos compartilham um espaço que concentra comércio, serviços e gastronomia. No Hotel Marbor, a procura por hospedagem e a recorrência de clientes também demonstram a atratividade da operação. A programação cultural e de lazer complementa essa movimentação, atraindo visitantes e ampliando as oportunidades para os estabelecimentos instalados no complexo.

Para o Grupo Marbor, que completou 38 anos em 2026, esses resultados fazem parte de uma gestão que acompanha o desempenho dos negócios e as necessidades de empresas, consumidores e hóspedes. Os indicadores de ocupação, circulação de público e desempenho das operações orientam decisões e ajudam a identificar oportunidades de investimento e crescimento.

A ocupação como indicador de preferência

Com cerca de 80 empreendimentos instalados e mais de 90% de ocupação, a Vila Helio reúne empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos em um espaço que combina infraestrutura comercial, serviços e circulação de público.

A diversidade de operações contribui para manter o complexo ativo e ampliar as possibilidades de consumo e relacionamento com os visitantes. A gestão privada do complexo contempla manutenção, conservação das áreas comuns e serviços de apoio, condições que contribuem para a atratividade dos imóveis e a permanência das empresas.

“Uma ocupação elevada é um indicador importante de atratividade, mas a consistência do negócio está na capacidade de manter essa demanda ao longo do tempo. Isso exige uma gestão próxima das operações, investimentos permanentes na infraestrutura e atenção à qualidade dos espaços. É assim que preservamos o valor dos nossos ativos e construímos relações duradouras com as empresas instaladas”, avalia Tatiana Borenstein, diretora do Grupo Marbor.

Hotel Marbor mantém procura e investe na modernização

O Hotel Marbor mantém uma demanda expressiva por hospedagem, com períodos de alta ocupação e clientes que retornam regularmente a Mogi das Cruzes. O empreendimento recebe profissionais, famílias, artistas, atletas e grupos que chegam à região para compromissos, eventos e lazer.

Com 107 apartamentos distribuídos em sete categorias, o hotel atende diferentes necessidades de hospedagem. A recorrência dos clientes e as avaliações nas plataformas especializadas estão entre os indicadores acompanhados pela administração para avaliar a qualidade dos serviços e a experiência dos hóspedes.

Além da hospedagem, o Hotel Marbor também vem ampliando sua relação com o público local por meio do café da manhã, disponível inclusive para quem não está hospedado. O serviço também ganha edições temáticas em datas como Dia das Mães, Dia dos Pais e Halloween, atraindo moradores de Mogi das Cruzes para experiências gastronômicas em diferentes ocasiões.

A operação também passa por uma nova etapa de investimentos. O projeto de retrofit do Hotel Marbor, iniciado no último trimestre de 2026, contempla a modernização de áreas comuns, com melhorias voltadas ao conforto dos hóspedes e à atualização da estrutura do empreendimento.

Ao longo do ano, a Vila Helio mantém uma programação cultural mensal diversificada, com eventos organizados pelo Grupo Marbor, administrador do espaço, e também realizados por meio da Lei de Incentivo à Cultura (LIC) de Mogi das Cruzes.) — Foto: Divulgação/Grupo Marbor

A programação cultural e de lazer também contribui para a circulação de visitantes na Vila Helio. Entre as atrações realizadas em 2026 estão o Sambadou na Vila, o Mogi Jazz & Blues Fest e o Dia de Brincar, iniciativas que reuniram diferentes públicos no Centro de Mogi das Cruzes.

Ao todo, os eventos realizados no complexo receberam mais de 10 mil pessoas. Além de ampliar as opções de lazer na cidade, essas atividades favorecem o contato do público com os estabelecimentos instalados na Vila Helio, especialmente os de gastronomia.

A programação de fim de ano dá continuidade a essa agenda, com apresentações de corais natalinos, presença do Papai Noel e bazar. As atrações já integram o calendário de atividades procuradas pelas famílias mogianas. Para este ano, a expectativa é receber entre 8 mil e 10 mil visitantes durante os dias de eventos.

Parte das iniciativas culturais conta com patrocínio por meio da Lei de Incentivo à Cultura (LIC) da Prefeitura de Mogi das Cruzes, enquanto outras são realizadas por organização privada.

O galpão localizado na Avenida Fernando Costa, em Mogi das Cruzes, tem 572,70 m² de área construída e integra o portfólio imobiliário do Grupo Marbor.) — Foto: Divulgação/Grupo Marbor

Crescimento acompanhado por investimentos

A expansão do portfólio imobiliário integra a estratégia de crescimento do Grupo Marbor, que administra mais de 20 mil m² de Área Bruta Locável (ABL) em imóveis comerciais. Entre os movimentos recentes estão a aquisição de duas propriedades ocupadas por agências do Banco do Brasil e do Itaú, na região central de Mogi das Cruzes, e a incorporação de um imóvel com 572,70 m² de área construída na Avenida Fernando Costa.

A ampliação do patrimônio ocorre em paralelo aos investimentos nos empreendimentos já administrados, como a modernização do Hotel Marbor e a conservação permanente da Vila Helio. A estratégia combina a qualificação dos ativos existentes com a identificação de novas oportunidades no mercado imobiliário.

“Nosso crescimento é resultado de decisões fundamentadas no desempenho dos negócios e na identificação de oportunidades. Acompanhamos indicadores, avaliamos a capacidade de cada empreendimento de gerar valor e direcionamos os investimentos para preservar a competitividade do portfólio. Temos uma visão de longo prazo, que combina a qualificação dos ativos existentes com a expansão para novos mercados”, afirma Tatiana.

Com negócios consolidados em Mogi das Cruzes e expansão de atuação, o Grupo Marbor mantém uma estratégia de crescimento baseada na gestão de seus empreendimentos, na valorização dos ativos e na identificação de oportunidades em diferentes mercados.

articles.title: Festival traz o Japão para Campo Grande com shows, cosplay e oficinas  | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento espera reunir 40 mil pessoas em três dias de programação com gastronomia oriental, concursos de cosplay, apresentações culturais e experiências tecnológicas em Campo Grande.
articles.summary: Evento espera reunir 40 mil pessoas em três dias de programação com gastronomia oriental, concursos de cosplay, apresentações culturais e experiências tecnológicas em Campo Grande.
articles.body:
Pratos da culinária oriental. — Foto: Divulgação.

Festival que acontece no próximo fim de semana promete três dias de um verdadeiro mergulho nos sabores, costumes e na cultura oriental. De 13 a 15 de novembro, o 6º Festival do Japão terá shows, concursos temáticos e até oficinas gratuitas de culinária oriental no Bosque Expo, espaço de eventos do Shopping Bosque dos Ipês, em Campo Grande .

A abertura oficial, na sexta-feira (13), terá como destaque a Samurai Run, corrida noturna temática com largada marcada para as 19h30. A proposta é unir esporte e cultura japonesa em uma experiência diferente para os participantes.

Entre as novidades desta edição está o Espaço Mirai 3D, área tecnológica dedicada a impressões tridimensionais, que apresentará réplicas detalhadas de personagens com quase dois metros de altura.

Oficinas gratuitas de culinária oriental

Com o tema “Japão à Mesa: sabores, técnicas e histórias”, as oficinas de culinária serão oferecidas pelo Senac, com apresentações sobre ingredientes, costumes e técnicas de preparo de pratos orientais.

As atividades serão realizadas na unidade móvel do Senac e conduzidas por profissionais e acadêmicos do curso superior de Tecnologia em Gastronomia.

Um dos destaques será o Laboratório do Umami, no qual os visitantes poderão participar de degustações às cegas para identificar o chamado quinto sabor, presente em ingredientes como cogumelos, missô e shoyu.

A programação inclui ainda oficinas sobre o preparo de arroz para sushi, onigiri, bentô, caldos japoneses, conservas e matcha. Também haverá espaço para receitas que revelam a influência da imigração japonesa na culinária regional, como o sobá, um dos pratos mais tradicionais de Campo Grande.

Outra atração será o Desafio do Hashi. No sábado (14), uma oficina vai explorar a fusão entre técnicas japonesas e ingredientes sul-mato-grossenses, com preparações como sashimi de pintado ao molho ponzu de limão-cravo e caldo de pacu com wakame.

Realizado pela Associação Cultural e Esportiva Nipo-Brasileira de Campo Grande, o festival espera receber 40 mil visitantes ao longo dos três dias. A entrada é gratuita, mediante a doação de 1 kg de alimento não perecível, que será destinado a instituições sociais do Estado.

Além das oficinas e experiências gastronômicas, a programação contempla:

Gastronomia e Cozinha Show: praça de alimentação com pratos clássicos da culinária japonesa e aulas práticas com chefs convidados.

Palco Cultural: apresentações tradicionais de taiko (tambores japoneses), danças folclóricas e shows musicais.

Concursos temáticos: disputas tradicionais e de cultura pop, incluindo o Miss Nikkey MS, o Concurso de Cosplay e o Anime Freestyle. As inscrições estão abertas ao público.

Bazar e lojas: feira de artigos orientais, vestuário, produtos da cultura pop japonesa, colecionáveis e artesanato.

6º Festival do Japão de Mato Grosso do Sul

Horário: sexta-feira a domingo, das 11h às 22h

Corrida temática: Samurai Run, sexta-feira (13), às 19h30

Local: Bosque Expo – Shopping Bosque dos Ipês (Avenida Cônsul Assaf Trad, 4.796, Parque dos Novos Estados, Campo Grande)

Entrada: gratuita, mediante doação de 1 kg de alimento não perecível.

articles.title: VÍDEO: Dupla invade escola, agride e rouba arma de vigilante no Acre | G1
articles.standfirst: Câmeras de segurança registraram a ação, que durou cerca de 30 segundos, na madrugada desta segunda-feira (9), em Rio Branco. Suspeitos fugiram a pé.
articles.summary: Câmeras de segurança registraram a ação, que durou cerca de 30 segundos, na madrugada desta segunda-feira (9), em Rio Branco. Suspeitos fugiram a pé.
articles.body:
Dois homens invadiram a Escola Governador José Augusto, em Rio Branco, e agrediram um vigilante — Foto: Câmeras de segurança

Dois homens invadiram a Escola Governador José Augusto, na Rua Três de Agosto, bairro Boa União, em Rio Branco , e agrediram um vigilante na madrugada desta segunda-feira (9). A ação, registrada por câmeras de segurança, durou cerca de 30 segundos e a vítima teve a arma de serviço roubada.

As imagens mostram o funcionário caminhando por um dos corredores da escola quando foi surpreendido pelos suspeitos, que usavam capacetes. Eles agrediram o vigilante com golpes na cabeça usando uma arma. A vítima caiu e colocou as mãos sobre a cabeça.

Em seguida, os criminosos retiraram a arma do profissional que, mesmo sem reagir, continuou sendo agredido com chutes na região do rosto e do corpo, além de socos na cabeça. Depois da violência, os dois homens fugiram correndo.

O g1 entrou em contato com a Polícia Civil e com a Secretaria de Justiça e Segurança Pública do Acre (Sejusp) e, até a última atualização desta reportagem, não havia obtido resposta de ambos. Até a última atualização desta matéria, ninguém havia sido preso.

Em nota, a Secretaria de Educação e Cultura (SEE-AC) informou que tomou conhecimento da invasão e confirmou que os criminosos agrediram o vigilante e levaram a arma de serviço dele.

Segundo a pasta, o profissional procurou atendimento médico e está temporariamente afastado das atividades.

"A SEE informa que a equipe de Segurança Escolar entrou em contato com a gestão da unidade e orientou a formalização de um boletim de ocorrência. Também foi solicitado o reforço das rondas ostensivas do policiamento escolar na região", disse o texto.

O governo do Estado, por meio da Secretaria de Estado de Educação e Cultura (SEE), informa que tomou conhecimento da ocorrência envolvendo a entrada de dois indivíduos na Escola Estadual José Augusto, em Rio Branco, que agrediram um vigilante e subtraíram sua arma de serviço.

O profissional procurou atendimento médico e encontra-se afastado temporariamente de suas atividades. A equipe de Segurança Escolar da SEE entrou em contato com a gestão da unidade e orientou a formalização de boletim de ocorrência, além de solicitar o reforço das rondas ostensivas do policiamento escolar na região.

A Secretaria acompanha a situação e reforça seu compromisso com a segurança dos estudantes, profissionais e de toda a comunidade escolar.

Rio Branco-AC, 9 de novembro de 2026. Reginaldo Prates - Secretário de Estado de Educação e Cultura

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Karlie Kloss reunite at Chiefs game, a decade after their rumored rift
articles.summary: The onetime BFFs have not been photographed together since 2018.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift and Karlie Kloss reunited at the Kansas City Chiefs game on Sunday, a decade after their rumored rift.

The two cheered on Swift's husband, Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce.

Kloss shocked Swifties in July when she attended the singer's wedding at Madison Square Garden.

It's a friendship story, baby — Taylor Swift and Karlie Kloss were spotted together for the first time in nearly a decade on Sunday.

The "Patient Zero" singer invited Kloss to join her inside her private suite at Arrowhead Stadium to cheer on husband Travis Kelce and the Kansas City Chiefs as they defeated the New York Jets. The two sat side by side, smiling and laughing the entire game, surrounded by Swift's mother Andrea Swift and mother-in-law Donna Kelce.

Swift and Kloss were last photographed together in August 2018, when the supermodel went backstage at the Reputation Stadium Tour's stop in Nashville. However, the friendly selfie did little to quiet speculation about a rift between the BFFs, after Kloss remained close to Kim Kardashian amid her and Kanye West's public feud with Swift.

Two months later, when she married Josh Kushner, her close friend of five years wasn't in attendance. The singer also didn't make an appearance at the couple's second ceremony in June 2019. Curiously, two of her rivals were on the guest list: Katy Perry, the reported inspiration for Swift's "Bad Blood," and Scooter Braun, whom she had accused of "manipulative bullying" after he purchased the masters of her first six albums that month.

But over the years since, the frost between Swift and Kloss has slowly thawed.

Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter .

In 2023, the model was spotted singing and dancing at a Los Angeles concert on Swift's Eras Tour. Out of the public eye, the two seemingly mended the rift. This past July, Swifties were shocked to see Kloss and her husband arriving at Madison Square Garden for the singer's wedding to Kelce.

Kloss remained mum about the invite when asked weeks later on the Today show. However, she couldn't help but gush about her friend's real-life love story: "What I will say is that they're an amazing couple and I'm so happy for them."

articles.title: Naruto live-action movie reveals a major clue about its storyline as a dangerous first mission takes centre stage
articles.summary: The upcoming Naruto live-action movie may be taking fans back to the moment that truly tested Naruto Uzumaki as a young ninja.
articles.body: The upcoming Naruto live-action movie may be taking fans back to the moment that truly tested Naruto Uzumaki as a young ninja. New details about the film’s reported storyline suggest that its first major adventure will draw from the early days of the beloved manga and anime. The project has already sparked debate over its casting choices and the ages of its central characters. Now, its reported plot offers a stronger clue about which part of Naruto’s journey could reach the big screen.Naruto live-action movie plot points to the first ninja missionAccording to a report from Knight Edge Media, the film will follow Naruto as he takes on his first mission with Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno. The reported synopsis describes a routine assignment that quickly turns into a dangerous encounter, forcing the young ninja to face a power he does not fully understand.The synopsis reads:"The Naruto story unfolds in a breathtaking alternate universe, where every child dreams of becoming a ninja. We follow Naruto Uzumaki, an exceptionally gifted but challenging new recruit, as he’s assigned to his first mission alongside reluctant teammates Sasuke and Sakura. The mission turns into something far more dangerous and sinister than anticipated, and Naruto is forced to confront his inner demons – including the literal demon that’s revealed to be the root of his own power."The description does not name the enemy or explain where the mission takes place. Still, it brings one of the franchise’s most memorable early storylines into focus.In the original manga and anime, Naruto’s first major assignment outside the village leads into the Land of Waves arc. The story introduces the dangerous rogue ninja Zabuza Momochi and his young companion, Haku. It also gives Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura their first serious test as a team.That storyline could offer the filmmakers a natural starting point. It has emotional stakes, intense fights and room to establish the bonds between the three young ninjas. However, the studio has not confirmed that Zabuza and Haku will appear in the movie.Naruto casting raises questions about character agesThe film’s casting process has also left fans guessing about the adaptation’s timeline. In July, Lionsgate reportedly sought Asian actors aged 18 and older to portray Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura as 16-year-old characters.That initially suggested the movie might move the characters forward from their original ages of around 12. But a second casting call, reportedly issued two weeks ago, sought actors aged 13 to 15 for Naruto and Sakura.The change has created uncertainty about how old the characters will be in the finished film. No official explanation has clarified the different age requirements.Production is expected to begin in the United Kingdom early next year. Until Lionsgate shares more details, the first-mission storyline remains the clearest indication of the direction the live-action Naruto movie could take.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.summary: Hilary Duff opened up about how she had to confront "scars from the past" after returning to the stage for her "Lucky Me Tour" following 20 years away.
articles.body: Hilary Duff is opening up about the "scars from the past" she had to confront as a former child star. In a recent interview with Billboard, the 39-year-old actress and singer, who rose to fame at 14 when she starred in the hit Disney Channel series "Lizzie McGuire," reflected on the lasting effects of childhood stardom as she discussed her return to music after more than a decade. In February, Duff released "Luck … Or Something," her first studio album since 2015's "Breathe In. Breathe Out." The album debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 chart. In June, Duff launched the "Lucky Me Tour," her first major tour in nearly two decades. BELLA THORNE SAYS HOLLYWOOD TREATED HER LIKE A KID ON SCREEN AND AN ADULT OFF CAMERA Before launching her tour, Duff gave an intimate performance for friends and family in Los Angeles in January. She told Billboard that she was so nervous during the show that her hand shook as she held the microphone. The "Younger" star recalled that after the performance, her son, Luca, told her he was proud of her for returning to the stage despite her fears. "That stuck with me, because it is scary, and I'm used to being so tough and strong," she said. "This industry really makes you very rough around the edges, where you're like, 'I've got to handle this, so I just will.'" "But it was scary to step onstage after 20 years and figure out my identity, and how I move my body and what I'm taking from my old persona and adding to who I am now," Duff continued. "It was a complicated thing to do, and I had to get over quite a few scars from the past." FORMER DISNEY STAR DYLAN SPROUSE SAYS ACTING AS A KID WAS ‘CHILD LABOR’ Although she stepped away from music for more than a decade, Duff said some of the habits she developed during her years as a child star have been difficult to shake. According to Billboard, Duff repeatedly referred to herself as a "Disney dog" during the interview, describing an ingrained impulse to "say yes and to go, go, go." DOLLY PARTON DEFIED COUNTRY MUSIC'S EXPECTATIONS FOR WOMEN AND BUILT A CAREER ON HER OWN TERMS: EXPERTS Duff also said returning to music as an adult has allowed her to take greater control of her career than she had as a child star. "It was wonderful building this on my terms," she said. "I don't mean that negatively in regard to how anything was handled in the past, because I was a child in the past. I wasn't muted, and I got to make decisions, but people made a lot of decisions for me because I didn't care or know enough to be like, 'Here's how I want this.'" articles.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight dominates Crunchyroll rankings, but its latest episode faces an unexpected ratings disaster
articles.summary: A strong streaming performance usually signals that an anime has found its audience.
articles.body: A strong streaming performance usually signals that an anime has found its audience. But even a popular series can stumble when an episode fails to deliver what viewers expect. The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System is facing that contrast after its latest instalment received a disappointing IMDb score. The setback comes at an interesting time, as the fantasy series recently climbed to the top of Crunchyroll's worldwide rankings, leaving its growing success and mixed episode reception at odds.The Exiled Heavy Knight episode 19 takes a hit on IMDbEpisode 19 has received a rating of 6.8/10 on IMDb, making it the second-lowest-rated episode of the series as of November 9, 2026. The score marks a noticeable drop from Episode 18, which earned 7.8/10.The change in pace may explain some of the difference. After several episodes focused on dangerous opponents, battles and Elymas Edvaughn's unusual approach to combat, the story takes a quieter route.Elymas and Ruche head to an underground lake after placing an order for new equipment with the blacksmith Veruga. Their break soon turns into a fishing contest when Mary, the leader of the Sea Dragon's Fang angler clan, challenges Elymas.The idea offers a chance to see a different side of the characters. Yet, viewers who had been following the anime for its action and clever use of game mechanics may not have welcomed the slower storyline with the same enthusiasm.A fishing competition is not necessarily a problem for a fantasy adventure. Such episodes can build relationships and give the main characters room to breathe. However, timing matters. After a run of intense encounters, the shift may have felt abrupt to some viewers.The 6.8 rating reflects the episode's reception on IMDb, although it does not establish why individual viewers rated it lower.The Exiled Heavy Knight continues to dominate Crunchyroll rankingsDespite the criticism surrounding Episode 19, the anime has maintained impressive momentum on streaming platforms. FlixPatrol's worldwide Crunchyroll TV show rankings placed The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System at No. 1 on November 7, 2026, with 78 points.It ranked ahead of established titles such as The Apothecary Diaries, Black Clover and Solo Leveling. That achievement suggests the series continues to attract a substantial audience, even as one episode struggles to match the reception of earlier instalments.Much of the appeal comes from Elymas himself. Rather than relying only on overwhelming strength, he uses his understanding of the game's mechanics to make an overlooked Heavy Knight class surprisingly formidable. That approach gives the series a distinct hook in a crowded fantasy anime landscape.With 26 episodes planned, the show still has room to regain momentum. A return to high-stakes battles, smart strategies and meaningful character development could help restore the excitement that drew viewers in. For now, its streaming success remains strong, even as Episode 19 stands out as a rare stumble.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.summary: Russell Brand was sentenced Monday after being found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in the U.K.
articles.body: Russell Brand has been sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison for rape and sexual assault. During sentencing on Monday, Judge Mr. Justice Joel Bennathan said Brand had demonstrated a "casual and arrogant disregard" for women’s right to refuse his sexual advances. "About 20 years ago, Russell Brand, you were becoming famous," Bennathan said. "You were clever — and in many people’s eyes, funny and charismatic. You had also become a sexual predator." The judge described one of Brand’s sexual assaults as "outrageous and possibly laddish, but also a criminal offense," adding that Brand’s behavior reflected his belief that "fame meant you could act how you liked, when you liked, unhindered by the rules by which decent people live." RUSSELL BRAND FOUND GUILTY OF ONE COUNT OF RAPE AND THREE COUNTS OF SEXUAL ASSAULT Bennathan also said Brand’s conduct showed a "casual arrogant disregard of anyone’s right to say no," and emphasized that women retain the right to refuse sexual contact "wherever they go, indeed whatever they drink." The judge said the victims suffered "profound and lasting" consequences, including trauma, humiliation, addiction and difficulty trusting others. He also praised the women for their "determination and bravery" after they endured Brand's assertions that they had lied about the encounters or consented to them. Bennathan said he considered Brand’s lack of significant prior convictions, the 17 years that had passed since the offenses and his work helping people struggling with addiction. However, he said good character and exemplary conduct should not normally be given significant weight in cases involving serious sexual offenses. According to Sky News, as Brand was taken from the dock by three guards, he turned to his wife and nodded, saying, "We'll be OK." Laura reportedly mouthed back: "I love you, I'll be OK." He was immediately taken into custody following the verdict, according to the BBC. Brand, 51, was accused of three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of attempted indecent assault involving six women between 1999 and 2009. One woman he was convicted of sexually assaulting gave an impact statement during Monday's proceedings, while three others submitted written statements to the prosecutor. Russell Brand has managed to move on and even forget," she wrote. "Over the years, hearing his voice on television, on social media or seeing his image made me jump." According to Sky News, Brand acknowledged that he had been "reckless" and used his fame to pursue sexual relationships, but insisted that the encounters were consensual. articles.title: Cameron Mathison Says He Couldn’t Sleep or Eat After Learning Wife Wanted to Separate: ‘I Would Spiral’
articles.summary: “I was at a real, real low in my life,” the actor said of his 2024 split from Vanessa Mathison after 22 years of marriage
articles.body:
Cameron Mathison and his wife of 22 years, Vanessa, separated in 2024

On a recent podcast interview, the General Hospital actor reflected on the split and admitted he would "spiral" in the aftermath of their separation

He credits his "training in meditation" for having a "very powerful effect on the mind"

Cameron Mathison is recalling how he coped during his split from his ex-wife, Vanessa .

Cameron and Vanessa, who wed in 2002 and share two children , announced their split in 2024 after 22 years of marriage. In an Instagram post , the couple shared that they made "the difficult decision to part ways" and called their kids — Lucas, 23, and Leila, 20— "our highest priority."

Appearing on the I Do Part Two podcast on Saturday, Oct. 7, the General Hospital actor, 57, reflected on how he would "spiral" amid the separation, which followed an already tumultuous period.

"I would definitely spiral. Like, what else can come? Almost dying from cancer, getting through it , during my recovery, my mom gets diagnosed with brain cancer, passes away. I lose my job. People very, very dear to me almost died, which is, you know, not my story to tell. Then my wife wanted a divorce after 23 years, my dog died in my house," he recalled. "I was like, wow, like, what's next?"

He cited his "practice of being mindful" as how he has learned to cope with challenges in his life, but admitted that it "fell off" at times amid his split from Vanessa, 59.

"When I found out that Vanessa wanted a full separation and to start seeing other people, I was at a real, real low in my life," he said. " I would spiral, not sleep at night and [wouldn't] eat."

He managed to get through it thanks to his "training in meditation and that training in cultivating gratitude or love or compassion," which he said has a "very powerful effect on the mind."

"It was the only thing that was saving me at that time," he said. "It was very effective for me."

Six months after the separation, Cameron and Vanessa's home, where they raised their kids, was "decimated" in the Los Angeles wildfires . "There's nothing there. Less than nothing. It's just all burnt to just ashes," he told Entertainment Tonight at the time. "We spent over a decade doing every detail of that house. It was something that the kids loved, it was where the kids wanted to raise their kids."

He told PEOPLE four months later that he was struggling with his sobriety in the aftermath of the loss. "I have to say, the pull and the thoughts are definitely stronger these last four months — more so than the last 20, 21 years of my life," he said.

"When I feel that craving, that want, that need, that trying to satisfy an inner problem with an outer solution — whether it's a mind-altering substance or whatever — I really try to turn inward and work on my inner qualities of love, compassion, patience, generosity, kindness, and train in meditation, work on that serenity through community, through my own spiritual practice," he shared. "And I haven't been great with it, to be honest, the last four months."

In August, Cameron and former Miss Maryland USA Taelyr Robinson went Instagram official when she shared a birthday tribute dedicated to the actor. He later posted a birthday tribute for her in October. "Beautiful inside and out, and somehow even more so on the inside," Cameron wrote. "Happy birthday beauty 🎂✨ The world's lucky to have you. And i am too:)"

articles.summary: El líder de Vox abrirá la semana en el programa del ente público presentado por David Broncano
articles.body: Este lunes, 9 de noviembre, David Broncano arrancará la semana en ‘La Revuelta’ recibiendo a Santiago Abascal, líder de Vox. El televisivo acoge la visita del máximo mandatario de la formación verde tras las de Pedro Sánchez, jefe del Ejecutivo; Gabriel Rufián, portavoz de ERC; e Irene Montero, líder de Podemos, hace unas semanas con motivo de las elecciones generales del 29 de noviembre (29N). El Teatro Albéniz de la capital de España se ha vestido de gala para la ocasión para recibir a Santiago Abascal. Eso sí, su visita no ha estado exenta de polémica. El pasado viernes, 6 de noviembre, las personas que iban a acudir a la primera entrega de la semana del espacio del ente público recibieron un e-mail cancelando su visita. El mencionado correo electrónico, enviado por una de las productoras del espacio televisivo, El Terrat, apuntaba que por “circunstancias especiales” se grabará en condiciones distintas de calendario y de público. Esto causó quejas y malestar entre los asistentes, que mostraron su enfado en la red social X. En este contexto, Santiago Abascal acudió al escenario para grabar la entrevista con David Broncano. Cabe recordar que el programa es grabado cada tarde en el plató del Teatro Albéniz de Madrid. Los medios de comunicación esperaban expectantes en la puerta del lugar para captar la llegada del líder de Vox. Abascal llegó acompañado de lo que parece ser su equipo de seguridad, al mismo tiempo que los periodistas se agolpaban sobre él. Además, había una gran cantidad de personas con la bandera de España en los alrededores que le recibieron al grito de “presidente, presidente” y aplausos y silbidos. El propio Santiago Abascal reaccionó con un saludo y un guiño a todos los presentes ante las muestras de cariño recibidas.

articles.body: Chris Rock is going into detail about the end of his marriage, admitting he wasn't the best husband and took accountability for mistakes he made in the relationship. During a recent interview with GQ, the 61-year-old comedian shared that there were many factors that caused the divorce, noting he cheated and was addicted to pornography during his marriage. articles.title: Erika Kirk blasts ‘beyond disgusting’ jokes after Dave Chappelle mocks Charlie Kirk’s assassination
articles.summary: “Ever since that guy Charlie Kirk got murdered, and I shouldn’t say this publicly, but I feel better,” Chappelle told fans at Madison Square Garden on Saturday night.
articles.body: Hours after Dave Chappelle made light of right-wing provocateur Charlie Kirk’s slaying, Kirk’s widow lashed out Sunday at “podcasters, comedians, and commentators” laughing “about political assassination.” Erika Kirk, CEO of the youth-focused conservative group Turning Point USA, said that such humor is “beyond disgusting” and that she fears for the “moral decay” of America. “To see leftist podcasters, comedians, and commentators laugh about political assassination as though it’s entertainment and the destruction of a human life is a punchline, is beyond disgusting,” she said on X. “My husband, Charlie Kirk, was killed in an act of political violence, something our two children and I will live with every day for the rest of our lives,” she said. “A culture that laughs at assassination is one of profound moral decay.” While Kirk didn’t mention Chappelle by name, her comments came after his gig Saturday night at Madison Square Garden in New York City. “Ever since that guy Charlie Kirk got murdered, and I shouldn’t say this publicly, but I feel better,” Chappelle said, according to fan videos of the show circulating online, which drew a smattering of uncomfortable chuckles from the stunned room. In another clip from Madison Square Garden that was making the rounds, Chappelle said, “I’m sure Charlie Kirk is looking up at us right now, laughing so hard he can’t breathe.” Erika Kirk’s denunciation also comes in the wake of an apology from the hosts of the “I’ve Had It” podcast for making light of the assassination. “On Thursday’s show, we laughed at a joke about Charlie Kirk,” Jennifer Welch and Angie Sullivan said in a joint statement Saturday. “It was an insensitive joke, and we should not have laughed. We regret it, and we apologize.” Welch and Sullivan were reading social media posts about the midterm elections and laughed at one that read, “We’re digging up Charlie Kirk and doing it again.” Charlie Kirk, 31, was gunned down on Sept. 10 last year during an outdoor speaking appearance at Utah Valley University. Former UVU student Tyler Robinson is accused of the slaying. “You do not have to agree with someone’s politics to recognize the value of their life,” Erika Kirk said Sunday. “This should not be so hard. Political violence must never be something this country tolerates, excuses, or celebrates.” Before the Kirk comment, some conservatives had embraced Chappelle for his years of mocking the transgender community. That goodwill has most likely come to an end. “Chappelle is just not funny anymore,” conservative megadonor Elon Musk said Sunday night on X. Reacting to one of the Madison Square Garden clips, Musk wrote, “Dave Chappelle is cruel.” A representative for Chappelle did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

articles.title: David Broncano y sus dudas por el público elegido por Vox para la visita de Santiago Abascal: "Creo que muestra una cosa que no es real"
articles.standfirst: El presentador confirmó que el equipo de Vox pidió gestionar la asistencia de espectadores para evitar posibles abucheos y que la conversación con el líder del partido no se viera interrumpida
articles.summary: El presentador confirmó que el equipo de Vox pidió gestionar la asistencia de espectadores para evitar posibles abucheos y que la conversación con el líder del partido no se viera interrumpida
articles.body: La entrevista de David Broncano a Santiago Abascal en 'La Revuelta' ha generado polémica incluso antes de su emisión. En los últimos días, varios espectadores han denunciado en redes sociales que el programa había cancelado su asistencia como público para la grabación de este lunes 9 de noviembre por "circunstancias especiales" relacionadas con la visita del líder de Vox. Ahora, el propio presentador ha explicado los motivos de este cambio y ha confirmado que el equipo de Santiago Abascal pidió hacerse cargo de la gestión del público, una petición a la que el programa de La 1 de RTVE ha accedido. Antes de comenzar la conversación con el presidente de Vox, enmarcada en la ronda de entrevistas a los principales candidatos a la Presidencia del Gobierno con motivo de las elecciones generales del próximo 29 de noviembre, David Broncano ha querido aclarar lo sucedido. "El equipo de Santiago Abascal nos pidió encargarse ellos de la gestión del público. A nosotros nos pareció bien, ahora explicaremos por qué, así que bienvenidos", ha explicado el presentador de 'La Revuelta' nada más arrancar el programa. La decisión había provocado numerosas reacciones en las redes sociales, donde algunos usuarios habían compartido mensajes de cancelación de sus invitaciones. En ellos, el programa comunicaba que la grabación había cambiado y que, por tanto, quedaba anulada la asistencia de los espectadores y sus acompañantes. También se indicaba que la emisión se realizaría "en condiciones distintas de calendario y de público" y se ofrecía la posibilidad de acudir otro día. Durante la entrevista, David Broncano ha explicado que existía cierto temor a que el público habitual de 'La Revuelta' dificultase la conversación con Santiago Abascal o rompiese su ritmo. El presentador ha reconocido que la audiencia del espacio había experimentado un cambio ideológico con el paso del tiempo. "Antiguamente había una representación más general de España" entre los asistentes, ha señalado, antes de añadir que, después de que durante bastante tiempo se acusase al programa de ser "prácticamente un panfleto estalinista", el público había virado "un poco hacia un público más de izquierdas". En este sentido, David Broncano ha justificado inicialmente que se aceptase la petición del equipo del líder de Vox porque no quería que el invitado pudiera utilizar una posible reacción negativa de los espectadores como argumento para eludir las preguntas o las cuestiones planteadas durante la conversación. "No me gustaría que te excusases en que la gente te haya abucheado", ha reconocido. Sin embargo, el presentador también ha aprovechado el encuentro para reflexionar sobre las consecuencias de haber permitido que Vox eligiera al público presente en el plató. David Broncano ha reconocido que ahora tiene "cierto reparo" con la decisión porque considera que la imagen que se proyectó durante la entrevista podría no corresponderse con la realidad. El conductor de 'La Revuelta' ha explicado que esperaba que las reacciones de los espectadores pudieran servir para matizar algunas de las opiniones expresadas por Santiago Abascal. No obstante, ante una audiencia que ha mostrado un apoyo mayoritario al invitado, ha considerado que sus intervenciones podían parecer validadas. "Pensaba que podría matizar muchas opiniones" de Santiago Abascal y que, "ante un apoyo tan unánime y tan frontal, parece que van a ser validadas", ha reflexionado David Broncano. A su juicio, con un público distribuido de forma aleatoria también habría habido espectadores que se mostrasen en contra de las declaraciones del líder de Vox. "Pensaba que podía tener sentido y ahora tengo un cierto reparo con la decisión, creo que muestra una cosa que no es real", ha concluido David Broncano, dejando patente sus dudas sobre una decisión que ha convertido la gestión del público en uno de los asuntos más comentados de la entrevista.

articles.title: Colorado mom who said daughter was secretly transitioned helps lead effort to ban boys in girls' sports
articles.summary: Erin Lee says her daughter was secretly socially transitioned at school, sparking the grassroots campaign behind Colorado's ballot measures.
articles.body: A Colorado mother who said her daughter was secretly socially transitioned at school helped lead a grassroots campaign that delivered major midterm victories, including measures restricting boys from playing in girls' spots in the traditionally Democratic state. Erin Lee, executive director and co-founder of Protect Kids Colorado, told Fox News Digital that the campaign's success was deeply personal, coming more than five years after an experience involving her daughter transformed her from a self-described left-leaning Democrat into a prominent parental rights advocate. "I co-founded Protect Kids Colorado because, five-and-a-half years ago, my 12-year-old daughter was secretly transitioned in her sixth-grade classroom," Lee said. EXCLUSIVE: RHODE ISLAND SCHOOL DISTRICT ACCUSED OF HIDING KIDS' GENDER TRANSITIONS FROM PARENTS In 2023, Lee, her husband and another couple, who at the time had sixth-grade daughters attending Wellington Middle-High School (WMS), sued educators at the Poudre School District with the assistance of America First Policy Institute and Illumine Legal, according to a copy of the lawsuit. Her group championed three ballot initiatives: Proposition 133, which increases penalties for child sex trafficking to life in prison without parole; Proposition 134, which would generally require students to compete on school sports teams corresponding to their biological sex; and Proposition 135, which would prohibit certain gender-transition surgeries for minors. JACKSON THOMPSON: COLORADO GOV-ELECT PHIL WEISER SIGNALS POSSIBLE CHANGES TO GIRLS' SPORTS BALLOT MEASURE Proposition 133 passed with approximately 62% support, while the other two measures, proposition 134, received roughly 52% and proposition 135 also received 52%. In the same election, Coloradans re-elected Democratic Sen. John Hickenlooper in a landslide with 60 percent of the vote. Lee said that the results demonstrate opposition to certain transgender policies that extend beyond traditional partisan lines. "Colorado broke ranks where they voted for Democrats," Lee said. "They also voted yes on these commonsense child protection measures." "I think that really speaks volumes to the fact that gender ideology is not a winning issue," she added. Lee said the campaign relied on more than 3,300 petition circulators, over 1,900 notaries and support from more than 1,000 churches. She claimed opponents spent more than $5 million, outspending her organization by more than 20 to 1. "This really was a movement of the people," Lee said. PORTLAND PUBLIC SCHOOLS RESCINDS BAN ON WOMAN WHO QUESTIONED CHILD'S GENDER IDENTITY ASSIGNMENT She also described the personal toll of her family's experience, alleging that school officials turned against her and her husband after they questioned their daughter's change in gender identity. "We walked through a living nightmare," Lee said. "Prior to 2021, I was your typical left-leaning Democrat voting, politically disengaged, virtue-signaling mom," Lee said. "And then it happened to us personally, and we were attacked by the school district when my daughter came home and declared she was suddenly a boy. We spoke up to the school and they vilified us. They sent in a well child check to check on our kids and assumed we weren't fit parents because we didn't instantly affirm. We were bullied with the suicide myth, ‘Would you rather have a living son or a dead daughter? You have to medicalize your child,’ and we're one of a few success stories," she said. Lee said her daughter one day moved on from the gender confusion, and asked her mom to become an advocate for others who might find themselves in a similar place. "It took almost a year to get her through this mentality," Lee said. "It included suicidal ideation and estrangement from people in our lives who didn't agree with us, not affirming her. She asked us to speak up to help other kids, and that's what launched me into sharing our story and it going viral, and really becoming this person that people could come to with their own stories of what they were going through, and I just learned how pervasive gender ideology is." Her daughter’s request, according to Lee, helped launch the advocacy work that ultimately grew into Protect Kids Colorado's statewide campaign. WASHINGTON STATE VOTERS APPEAR TO PASS FIRST-EVER BALLOT MEASURE SEPARATING BOYS AND GIRLS SPORTS Lee said she sees the election results as evidence of a broader cultural shift. "Gender ideology is a house of cards," she said, arguing that the Colorado vote could inspire similar efforts elsewhere. "The voters have spoken," Lee said. "We've come a long way culturally for this to have passed." A spokesperson for Poudre School District told Fox News Digital in a statement that, "Poudre School District does not comment on individual students, consistent with federal student privacy law." The spokesperson added that "the claims in Lee v. Poudre School District R-1 were dismissed by the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado. That dismissal was affirmed by the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit in April 2025. The plaintiffs subsequently petitioned the U.S. Supreme Court for review, and the Court denied that petition in October 2025. At no stage of this litigation was the district found liable." articles.title: Skims offers refunds after facing backlash for $148 advent calendar of hair ties, key chains
articles.summary: “That Skims advent calendar looks like what I’d find on the floor if I pulled my headboard away from the wall,” one person wrote on social media.
articles.body: After it received an onslaught of criticisms over its pricey advent calendars, Skims is trying to correct course. In a statement shared with TODAY.com on Tuesday, a Skims spokesperson said that the company is “aware of the feedback” on the advent calendar and that it is offering refunds. The company recently became the center of controversy when social media users discovered that the $148 product contained items like hair ties and Skims-branded bobby pins. It led many customers to call the product a “scam” and the “worst advent calendar ever.” “I’m hoping this is a prank and the last one is a $150 gift card for all my money back,” influencer Kayla Ryan said as she unboxed the calendar. Another social media user compared the advent calendar to the odds and ends often found in the bottom of a purse. “I can’t believe I’ve had a Skims Advent Calendar in the bottom of my purse for months, what a surprise,” the Threads user wrote. In the statement, the Skims spokesperson acknowledged that “for some, the calendar didn’t meet expectations.” “We have personally contacted every customer who purchased the calendar and offered them a choice of a full refund or a SKIMS credit to put towards other products,” the spokesperson said in the statement. “We want every customer to be truly happy with what they receive from SKIMS. Their feedback matters to us and will directly shape how we approach future releases.” The calendar, which features 12 days of small surprises, is listed on the Skims website as an “accessories advent calendar.” And the product, while it is pricey, is sold out with a waitlist. According to the website, the contents include key chains, hair ties and scrunchies, clips, bobby pins and a compact mirror. Since the product’s release, videos of shoppers disappointingly unboxing the calendars have spread rapidly across the internet. One such video, posted Thursday, had drawn more than 47.7 million views as of Saturday afternoon. Many criticized the calendar’s price tag, saying the collection of products couldn’t possibly cost anywhere near the sale price. “I just watched a girl on TikTok unwrap the SKIMS advent calendar and I’m actually offended 😭 $148 for THAT?! I know Kim didn’t put some hair ties, clips and keychains in a box, slap SKIMS on it and expect people to act like this is luxury. That box isn’t worth $20. Be serious. 😂” a social media user wrote. Others said that the calendar was poorly curated. “For SKIMS to be a CLOTHING brand and not include a single piece of clothing in the SKIMS advent Christmas calendar is crazy and ridiculous actually 😂🤣 150$ for Bobby pins, scrunchies and tree ornaments WOW” another social media user wrote. And a whole lot of people made jokes about it. “That Skims advent calendar looks like what I’d find on the floor if I pulled my headboard away from the wall,” a person wrote. Another social media user joked: “Eugh. My cat saw the skims advent calendar and won’t shut up about it. 🙄” There were, however, a couple of people who weren’t so ready to rail against the company, pointing out that the Skims website was transparent about what was inside the calendar. “If the contents were disclosed, you ignored the description, spent $148, and then acted completely blindsided by what you received, some of that responsibility belongs to YOU,” another social media user said.

articles.title: El regalo de Santiago Abascal a David Broncano provoca un encontronazo entre ambos: "Yo no comparto ese término"
articles.standfirst: El líder de Vox le ha entregado una bandera de la ciudad autónoma para recordar la crisis migratoria en la frontera, la cual ha calificado de "invasión", un término que el presentador ha dejado claro que no comparte
articles.summary: El líder de Vox le ha entregado una bandera de la ciudad autónoma para recordar la crisis migratoria en la frontera, la cual ha calificado de "invasión", un término que el presentador ha dejado claro que no comparte
articles.body: Santiago Abascal sorprendió a David Broncano con un regalo muy significativo durante su visita a 'La Revuelta'. El presidente de Vox ha acudido al programa de La1 de RTVE con una bandera de Ceuta como obsequio para el presentador, un detalle con el que quiso recordar la crisis migratoria vivida en la ciudad autónoma y reivindicar su particular interpretación de lo sucedido en la frontera. "Tiene que ver con la dignidad de todos nosotros", ha explicado el dirigente político al entregar una caja blanca que contenía la bandera. Santiago Abascal ha querido conmemorar así los 100 días que, según su interpretación, habían transcurrido desde lo que considera una "invasión" en Ceuta, en referencia a la situación migratoria en la frontera. Como es habitual en el formato de 'La Revuelta', los invitados acuden al plató con algún obsequio para David Broncano. En esta ocasión, el líder de Vox ha asegurado que había recibido diferentes sugerencias sobre qué llevar al programa, entre ellas un extintor o una caja para que "fueran metiendo las cosas", en una alusión a una posible suspensión del espacio. Finalmente, se ha decantado por la bandera de Ceuta, que ha entregado al presentador durante los primeros compases de la entrevista. David Broncano desplegado el obsequio ante las cámaras y lo ha colocado sobre su mesa, donde ha permanecido durante la entrevista. Santiago Abascal, por su parte, le pidió que la mantuviera también en los siguientes programas hasta que se resolviera la situación. El regalo dio pie a uno de los primeros momentos de tensión de la entrevista. David Broncano ha querido matizar que no comparte la utilización del término "invasión" para describir lo ocurrido en la frontera de Ceuta, una expresión que Santiago Abascal emplea para referirse a la crisis migratoria. Aunque ambos han mostrado diferencias en la manera de interpretar los acontecimientos, han coincidido en señalar los graves problemas que la situación ha provocado entre la población de Ceuta. El presentador, que también ha hecho referencia a la defensa de los territorios, ha aceptado el regalo del dirigente de Vox, aunque sin asumir el significado político que este pretendía atribuirle. De esta manera, la bandera de Ceuta se ha convertido en uno de los elementos más destacados de la visita de Santiago Abascal a 'La Revuelta', en una entrevista marcada también por las diferencias ideológicas entre el invitado y el presentador.

articles.title: "Un orgasmo político": Pedro Sánchez recuerda el momento en que Donald Trump entregó la Copa del Mundo a España
articles.standfirst: El presidente del Gobierno ha recordado la victoria de la selección española en la final del Mundial celebrada en Estados Unidos durante la entrevista con Javier Ruiz en La Séptima
articles.summary: El presidente del Gobierno ha recordado la victoria de la selección española en la final del Mundial celebrada en Estados Unidos durante la entrevista con Javier Ruiz en La Séptima
articles.body: Pedro Sánchez ha dejado una de las declaraciones más llamativas de su última entrevista televisiva al recordar la victoria de la selección española de fútbol en la final del último Mundial celebrada en Estados Unidos. El presidente del Gobierno ha reconocido que ver a Donald Trump entregar el trofeo a los jugadores españoles fue para él "un orgasmo político", una expresión con la que ha descrito la satisfacción que le produjo aquel momento. El secretario general del PSOE se ha pronunciado sobre este asunto durante una entrevista que ha conducido Javier Ruiz en La Séptima, en la que también ha abordado la organización del Mundial de 2030 y la polémica sobre la elección de la sede de la final. Se trata de la segunda aparición televisiva reciente de Pedro Sánchez, después de su paso por 'La Revuelta' el pasado 23 de octubre. Al recordar el triunfo de España en Estados Unidos, el jefe del Ejecutivo ha destacado el simbolismo de recibir el trofeo de manos del presidente estadounidense. "Ganar la Copa del Mundo en Estados Unidos y que Donald Trump se la diera a la selección española para mí fue un orgasmo político", ha afirmado Pedro Sánchez. Más allá de recordar el éxito deportivo, el presidente del Gobierno ha defendido la candidatura conjunta de España, Portugal y Marruecos para organizar el Mundial de 2030. Pedro Sánchez ha explicado que la iniciativa partió de los dos países ibéricos, que posteriormente incorporaron a Marruecos al proyecto. "Hay dos países que lanzamos esta idea, como España y Portugal, e incorporamos a un país hermano como Marruecos", ha señalado. Asimismo, Pedro Sánchez ha recordado que España será el país que acoja más partidos del campeonato, aunque ha insistido en que la decisión sobre dónde se disputará la final corresponde exclusivamente a la FIFA. El presidente del Gobierno también ha expresado su deseo de que la selección española vuelva a proclamarse campeona del mundo en la próxima cita mundialista. "Ganamos en Sudáfrica, ganamos en Nueva York, hombre, en 2030 nos toca ganar en España, ¿no?", ha comentado Pedro Sánchez. Las declaraciones de Pedro Sánchez llegan en un momento de debate sobre el reparto de los encuentros del Mundial de 2030 y, especialmente, sobre qué país albergará la gran final del torneo. Aunque España es uno de los principales organizadores y acogerá el mayor número de partidos, existe preocupación en el entorno de la Real Federación Española de Fútbol (RFEF) ante la posibilidad de que el encuentro decisivo termine celebrándose en Marruecos. La cuestión también ha llegado al terreno político. Alberto Núñez Feijóo propuso la semana pasada que España se retire de la organización del Mundial si la FIFA no le concede la celebración de la final, una posibilidad que añadiría todavía más tensión al debate sobre la distribución de los encuentros de la cita que tendrá lugar en 2030.

articles.title: Bruce Springsteen fan club founders say political fights, El-Sayed endorsement led to shutdown: report
articles.summary: Bruce Springsteen's endorsement of Michigan's senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed proved the final straw for the Spring-Nuts fan club founders as group shutters.
articles.body: A Bruce Springsteen fan club couldn't escape the badlands and shuttered over political commentary. Founded more than a decade ago, the "Spring-Nuts" Facebook group dedicated to The Boss noticed its 18,000 members were no longer focused on his music as they battled against "hateful" online discourse due to Springsteen's public stances and recent endorsement of Michigan's senator-elect, Abdul El-Sayed. "As the world grew increasingly divisive, hostile, those tensions inevitably spilled into our little corner of the E Street world," founders Julie and Howie Chaz said in a statement posted on Sunday, Nov. 8, according to Asbury Park Press. BRUCE SPRINGSTEEN SPARKS FAN FURY AFTER BACKING ABDUL EL-SAYED IN MICHIGAN SENATE RACE "What should have been respectful differences of opinion too often deteriorated into personal attacks, bullying, insults, and some genuinely vile and hateful rhetoric." Springsteen embarked on the "Land of Hope and Dreams" tour earlier this year with the E Street Band and legendary guitarist Tom Morello. The 20-date tour across North America was slated in response to President Donald Trump and the "No Kings" protests. BRUCE SPRINGSTEEN REIGNITES TRUMP FEUD, SAYS 'CRITICAL PATRIOTISM' DEFINES A PATRIOT "We are living through dark, disturbing and dangerous times, but do not despair – the cavalry is coming," Springsteen said while announcing the tour on social media in February. "We will be rocking your town in celebration and in defense of America – American democracy, American freedom, our American Constitution and our sacred American dream – all of which are under attack by our wannabe king and his rogue government in Washington, D.C." He added, "Everyone, regardless of where you stand or what you believe in, is welcome – so come on out and join the United Free Republic of E Street Nation for an American spring of rock 'n' rebellion! I’ll see you there!" "Spring-Nuts" founder Howie Chaz admitted that as Springsteen became "more outspoken about his politics," the group administrators were tasked with a "difficult balancing act" of respecting "his absolute right" while maintaining an ethical online community. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "How could we be a Bruce Springsteen fan community trying to protect that harmony and camaraderie and ignore messages and statements coming directly from the very artist who brought us all together," Howie said. Springsteen's November endorsement of El-Sayed as "a fighter for our American Constitution" was the final straw for admins. "Mr. Sayed campaigned with Hasan Piker who openly made horrific statements that America deserved 9/11," Howie said. "After a Michigan synagogue was attacked back in March, obviously an act of terrorism, Sayed rationalized it by saying 'Hurt people hurt people' standing right next to the antisemitic streamer Hasan Piker who made the despicable 9/11 statement." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE His endorsement was "deeply disappointing to us, given our concerns as proud Jews," Julie and Howie said. "We certainly don't believe Bruce intended for his message to make fans feel unwelcome. But very unfortunately, some of his fans appointed themselves the gatekeepers of who was and wasn't worthy of belonging in the E Street community." While the group's annual Seaside Serenade and Spring-Nuts podcasts will continue under a different name, the group will rebrand with a focus on music in general, Howie told the Asbury Park Press. "One thing we want to make absolutely clear is that Julie and I can NEVER thank Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band enough for the decades of music, memories, inspiration, and absolute JOY they have brought into our lives," Howie said on Facebook. articles.title: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’
articles.summary: Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison said in an earnings call that AI will ”significantly” reshape its business, and compared its impact on film to CGI.
articles.body: During Paramount Skydance’s latest earnings call, CEO David Ellison said “it’s hard to imagine” AI won’t have a bigger impact on the film industry than CGI. In response to a question about the company’s outlook for AI, Ellison said: > “I think when you zoom out and look at production, AI really has the potential to be the biggest creative unlock in modern history. The last time we saw anything close to this was really the, you know, advent of CGI and digital composites in the early 90s. That technology gave birth to amazing stories like Jurassic Park and Terminator 2, and it’s hard to imagine that AI is not going to have a more significant impact than that. And I personally believe that’s going to be an incredible unlock on creativity.” Ellison gave Terminator as an example, describing how it cost $4 million to make, but “if you wanted to make that picture today, shot for shot, it’s $60 to 70 million.” He went on to suggest AI might be able to help with that: “We think these tools will help unlock more original storytelling by being able to make the budgets more digestible to be able to take that amount of risk.” Ellison said AI will “significantly” reshape Paramount Skydance’s business, saying the company has been developing its own AI tools. As a result of those tools, Ellison claims, “content will be easier to produce, projects across the organization will speed up, and how we work will transform.” He emphasized that “all of this makes the value of premium IP and live events more valuable, not less.” Ellison also noted that “in a world of AI slop, we think there will always be a premium for truly hand-crafted storytelling.” He added, “We also continue to believe that artificial intelligence is a tool for artists and will never be a replacement for them.”
